text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"The no-store response directive forbids caches from storing any part of the request or the response.","verdict":"SUPPORTED","reasoning":"Passage 0 states that under no-store a cache MUST NOT store any part of either the immediate request or the response.","citations":[{"index":0,"quote":"The no-store response directive indicates that a cache MUST NOT store any part of either the immediate request or the response"}]},{"claim_text":"The unqualified private directive allows shared caches to store the response.","verdict":"CONTRADICTED","reasoning":"Passage 2 states the opposite for shared caches: a shared cache MUST NOT store the response; a private cache MAY store it.","citations":[{"index":2,"quote":"The unqualified private response directive indicates that a shared cache MUST NOT store the response"}]}]}
